tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a single CCD session by ID, or for this session with "self": its sessionId, title, cwd, originCwd (the folder it was opened in), branch and worktree, and `link`, which opens the session in this app from outside it.

session_id.description: The sessionId to look up, or the literal string "self" for this session.

tools.name: set_session_title
tools.description: Rename a CCD session — another session, or this one. Titles the app generated are replaced without asking.

session_id.description: The sessionId of the session to rename, or the literal string "self" to rename this session.
